rules.name: Discord cache
rules.why: Discord's web cache (Stable, PTB and Canary). Your login, servers and messages are never touched.
sources: Discord is an Electron app; its Chromium caches live in Cache / Code Cache / GPUCache under %APPDATA%\discord*.

rules.name: Slack cache
rules.why: Slack's web cache. Your workspaces, messages and sign-in are never touched.
sources: Slack is an Electron app; its Chromium caches live under %APPDATA%\Slack.

rules.name: Microsoft Teams (classic) cache
rules.why: Classic Teams web cache. Your chats and sign-in are never touched.
sources: Classic Teams is an Electron app; its caches live under %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Teams.

rules.name: Spotify cache
rules.why: Spotify's streaming data cache. Your account, playlists and downloads are never touched.
sources: Spotify's media cache is stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Spotify\Data (Storage/Data); it is rebuilt on playback.

rules.name: VS Code cache
rules.why: VS Code's cached data. Your settings, extensions and workspaces are never touched.
sources: VS Code (Electron) stores CachedData / Cache / GPUCache under %APPDATA%\Code; these are regenerated.

rules.name: Cursor cache
rules.why: Cursor's cached data. Your settings, extensions and workspaces are never touched.
sources: Cursor (VS Code / Electron based) stores CachedData / Cache / GPUCache under %APPDATA%\Cursor.
